redistribution_policy: Reference-only metadata. Do not commit raw third-party source trees into CryptoShift; fetch at pinned commit SHA when running external evaluations.

repositories.purpose: Reference RSA, ECDSA, ECDH, TripleDES, and SHA-1 primitive usage patterns in Python.
repositories.reproducible_fetch_command: git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/pyca/cryptography.git && cd cryptography && git checkout f86cc742a9d2fd6b9f11a4f78831f1085719d050

repositories.purpose: Reference NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) key encapsulation and FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) digital signature usage.
repositories.reproducible_fetch_command: git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/open-quantum-safe/liboqs-python.git && cd liboqs-python && git checkout 1b8e9a95c07d1a4b6d89941621e0a480f685a264

repositories.purpose: Reference TLS cipher suite and key exchange configuration patterns.
repositories.reproducible_fetch_command: git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/tlsfuzzer/tlslite-ng.git && cd tlslite-ng && git checkout 09b4b6a1524a78b4b9c871225d3629873d0857e4
